subtitle: Master the iconic off-beat rhythms of Jamaica. Learn the spiritual and cultural foundation of reggae and the energetic precursor of ska.

introduction.title: One Love, One Rhythm
introduction.text: Reggae revolutionized popular music by emphasizing the off-beat, creating a hypnotic, meditative groove that became a global phenomenon.

columns.title: Off-Beat Revolution
columns.text: Reggae revolutionized popular music by emphasizing the off-beat, creating a hypnotic, meditative groove that became a global phenomenon.

columns.title: Cultural Movement
columns.text: More than just music, reggae carries messages of peace, unity, and social consciousness rooted in Jamaican culture and Rastafarian spirituality.

cards.title: Classic Reggae Skank
cards.description: All upstrokes on beats 2 and 4 (and "and" of 1 and 3)

fields.label: Pattern
fields.value: - U - U - U - U

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: Laid-back, relaxed groove with emphasis on off-beats

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Complete rhythmic displacement emphasizing weak beats

items: No Woman No Cry - Bob Marley

cards.title: One Drop
cards.description: Emphasis only on beat 3, with space on beat 1

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: Spacious, hypnotic groove characteristic of roots reggae

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Extreme syncopation with focus on beat 3 only

items: Get Up Stand Up - Bob Marley

cards.title: Rockers
cards.description: More driving rhythm with emphasis on all four beats

fields.label: Pattern
fields.value: D - U - D - U -

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: More energetic and driving than classic skank

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Balanced rhythm with both down and upstrokes emphasized

cards.title: Ska Upstroke
cards.description: Fast upstrokes on every off-beat

fields.label: Pattern
fields.value: - U - U - U - U

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: Energetic, bouncy feel characteristic of ska music

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Precursor to reggae, emphasizing upbeats at faster tempo

items: A Message to You Rudy - The Specials

cards.title: Steppers
cards.description: Four-on-the-floor with hi-hat on off-beats

fields.label: Pattern
fields.value: D - D - D - D -

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: Modern, driving reggae feel

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Contemporary reggae adaptation with steady four-beat emphasis

cards.title: Reggae-Rock Fusion
cards.description: Rock strumming with reggae off-beat emphasis

fields.label: Pattern
fields.value: D U D U with reggae emphasis

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: Fusion of rock energy with reggae groove

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Contemporary fusion maintaining reggae feel in rock context

cards.title: Dub Style
cards.description: Minimal playing with emphasis on space and effects

fields.label: Pattern
fields.value: Sparse, effects-heavy

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: Spacious, echo-heavy, minimal approach

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Emphasis on space, echo, and minimal rhythmic elements

cards.title: Dancehall
cards.description: Modern reggae with electronic influences

fields.label: Pattern
fields.value: Digital reggae with modern elements

fields.label: Feel
fields.value: Contemporary, often faster tempo with digital elements

fields.label: Theory
fields.value: Modern evolution of reggae with hip-hop and electronic influences

fields.label: Influence

fields.label: Significance
fields.value: Music as spiritual expression and social commentary

fields.label: Influence
fields.value: Emphasis on peace, love, unity, and social justice

fields.label: Significance

cards.title: Off-Beat Emphasis
cards.description: The defining characteristic of reggae guitar

fields.label: Technique
fields.value: Upstrokes on beats 2 and 4, and off-beats

fields.label: Practice Approach
fields.value: Start with metronome, emphasize upstrokes only

fields.label: Common Mistakes
fields.value: Playing on downbeats, rushing the upstrokes

cards.title: Clean Tone
cards.description: Reggae typically uses clean, crisp guitar tones

fields.label: Technique
fields.value: Clean amp settings, possible chorus or reverb

fields.label: Practice Approach
fields.value: Focus on clarity and articulation

fields.label: Common Mistakes
fields.value: Using too much distortion or effects

cards.title: Chord Voicings
cards.description: Simple but effective chord progressions

fields.label: Technique
fields.value: Major and minor triads, occasional sevenths

fields.label: Practice Approach
fields.value: Master basic open chords and barre chords

fields.label: Common Mistakes
fields.value: Overcomplicating chord voicings

cards.title: Rhythmic Precision
cards.description: Exact timing is crucial for authentic reggae feel

fields.label: Technique
fields.value: Precise upstroke timing, consistent tempo

fields.label: Practice Approach
fields.value: Practice with metronome, record yourself

fields.label: Common Mistakes
fields.value: Rushing or dragging the beat

cards.title: Metronome Off-Beat
cards.description: Learn to feel reggae timing

fields.label: Exercise
fields.value: Set metronome to click on beats 2 and 4 only

fields.label: Focus
fields.value: Feeling the off-beat as the main pulse

fields.label: Progression
fields.value: Add guitar upstrokes, then chord changes

cards.title: Basic Skank Pattern
cards.description: Master the fundamental reggae rhythm

fields.label: Exercise
fields.value: Play upstrokes on 2, 4, and the "and" of 1 and 3

fields.label: Focus
fields.value: Consistent upstroke technique and timing

fields.label: Progression
fields.value: Add dynamics, palm muting variations

cards.title: Chord Progression Practice
cards.description: Apply reggae rhythm to common progressions

fields.label: Exercise
fields.value: Play reggae skank over I-vi-IV-V progressions

fields.label: Focus
fields.value: Smooth chord changes while maintaining rhythm

fields.label: Progression
fields.value: More complex progressions, key changes

cards.title: Song Study
cards.description: Learn complete reggae songs

fields.label: Exercise
fields.value: Master full arrangements of classic reggae songs

fields.label: Focus
fields.value: Authentic feel, arrangement understanding

fields.label: Progression
fields.value: Improvisation, creating original arrangements
